members.name: market_breadth_signal_v1
members.thesis: Market breadth — the proportion of stocks advancing vs declining — diverges from the headline NIFTY 50 index during distribution (narrow rally in 5-10 heavy-weight stocks while breadth deteriorates) and accumulation (broad-based buying while index is flat due to weakness in heavyweights). When NIFTY
entry_long: breadth_ema > 1.2 (but majority of stocks are actually advancing)
entry_short: breadth_ema < 0.8 (but majority of stocks are actually declining)
members.exit_target: NIFTY 50 moves 20 bps in direction of breadth (reversal from divergence)
members.exit_stop: NIFTY 50 makes another new high/low extending 10 bps beyond entry
filters: India_VIX < 22; in high VIX, breadth divergences may not revert (panic selling)
skip first 15 min (breadth metrics need stabilization) and last 10 min
divergence is more reliable when NIFTY is near day's VWAP (not extreme trend)
weaknesses: Breadth divergence can persist for extended periods (2+ hours) before resolving. The 30-bar time stop may exit positions prematurely before the thesis plays out.
On days with heavy FII selling in large-caps only (e.g., MSCI rebalance), breadth divergence is genuine and NIFTY decline will persist despite positive breadth.
Computing real-time breadth for all 50 stocks requires monitoring 50 simultaneous data feeds, which is resource-intensive and may have data latency issues.

members.name: composite_breadth_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 50 constituents — trade the 5 most dislocated from breadth signal
members.thesis: Market breadth — the proportion of stocks advancing versus declining — provides information about the strength or weakness of an index move that price alone cannot convey. A NIFTY 50 rally driven by only 10-15 stocks (narrow breadth) is fragile, while a rally with 35+ advancers (broad breadth) is su
entry_long: NIFTY_Trend < 0 (NIFTY falling) AND Breadth_EMA > 0.55 (majority advancing despite index fall)
Breadth_Divergence > 0 (positive divergence — breadth stronger than index)
Target stock: close < vwap AND ROC(close, 10) < -10 bps (lagging the breadth signal)
entry_short: NIFTY_Trend > 0 (NIFTY rising) AND Breadth_EMA < 0.45 (majority declining despite index rise)
Breadth_Divergence < 0 (negative divergence — breadth weaker than index)
Target stock: close > vwap AND ROC(close, 10) > 10 bps (leading the narrow rally)
filters: No entries before 09:25 (need breadth warm-up) or after 15:10
At least 40 of 50 NIFTY stocks must have traded in the last 5 bars
None — strategy explicitly trades breadth divergences regardless of trend
Bid-ask spread < 5 bps on target stock
weaknesses: Breadth divergences can persist for 1-3 hours before resolving — NIFTY can continue rallying on narrow breadth, causing premature short entries to be stopped out
Using ROC(close, 5) for advance/decline classification is sensitive to the lookback — a 5-bar lookback is noisy and can flip rapidly, creating false breadth signals
The target stock selection (most dislocated from breadth signal) adds a subjective element and may select stocks with idiosyncratic reasons for their dislocation (news, earnings, etc.)
members.prior_art: NYSE Advance-Decline Line (McClellan Oscillator); Zweig Breadth Thrust; intraday breadth less documented but used by institutional trading desks; Quantopian community explored similar concepts

members.name: index_correlated_breakout_v1
members.thesis: Individual stock breakouts that coincide with NIFTY 50 or Bank NIFTY breaking their own key levels have a significantly higher success rate than standalone breakouts. When both the stock AND the index break out simultaneously, it signals macro-level buying/selling pressure that lifts/sinks the entir
entry_long: stock_close > stock_session_high[t-1] (stock making new session high)
nifty_close > nifty_session_high[t-1] (NIFTY also making new session high within last 3 bars)
entry_short: stock_close < stock_session_low[t-1] (stock making new session low)
nifty_close < nifty_session_low[t-1] (NIFTY also making new session low within last 3 bars)
members.exit_stop: stock_VWAP OR 0.3% from entry, whichever is tighter
filters: dual VWAP alignment (stock + NIFTY both on same side of VWAP)
weaknesses: Synchronized stock + index breakouts are rare — may occur 0-1 times per day across the universe
High correlation requirement (>0.6) means in low-correlation regimes (sector rotation), the strategy misses opportunities
Index breakout can be driven by one heavyweight stock (e.g., Reliance), creating false correlation with the specific stock being traded
